# The Librarian's Ledger

> Writing on Bitcoin, money, and the people who regulate it, read from the filings and the footnotes, plus a standing board of the world's biggest assets ranked by market value.

Every post cites its primary sources (filings, rulemakings, court dockets, on-chain data) and closes with a "where I could be wrong" section. The asset boards are refreshed automatically from market data; their figures are as of the timestamp shown on the page.

Part of the m8k.io family of publications by "Mr. Librarian" (index: https://m8k.io/llms.txt).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://ledger.m8k.io/): newest posts and the boards
- [Biggest assets board](https://ledger.m8k.io/board.html): the world's largest assets (gold, silver, companies, Bitcoin) ranked by value
- [Bitcoin](https://ledger.m8k.io/bitcoin.html): Bitcoin's standing on the board, holders and supply
- [Crypto](https://ledger.m8k.io/crypto.html): the largest crypto assets
- [Bitcoin treasuries](https://ledger.m8k.io/treasuries.html): companies, ETFs, countries and others holding Bitcoin
- [Money worldwide](https://ledger.m8k.io/money-worldwide.html): money supply, reserves, gold, exchange rates and debt by country
- [Tags](https://ledger.m8k.io/tags.html): every post grouped by subject

## Notes for automated readers

- Every published post is listed in https://ledger.m8k.io/sitemap.xml (with last-modified dates) and the newest in https://ledger.m8k.io/feed.xml.
- This blog moved from mistertranslation.com/finance/ on 2026-10-10; old addresses 301 here.
